ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixel field with approximately 10-12% high-intensity (white) punctate features; sharp contrast between scarring and primary integument.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white punctate blobs (mottling) scattered across both lobes with higher density in the medial regions; a distinct small contiguous white patch is located at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate calculated angle of 52 degrees between the leading edges of the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge of both lobes; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-6 pixel depth) isolated against the lower-intensity background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature of the trailing edges on both lobes, sweeping towards pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-4 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle scarring scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jaggedness/chipping along the entire trailing edge and dense white punctate scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-intensity white marker localized on the posterior-distal edge of the right lobe tip.
